3. The same long horizontal menu button plate in its normal state, exactly the same size and shape, with the center filled with a deep midnight-indigo panel, calmer and less glowing.
4. Bottom: a small round medallion button, about 10% of the sheet width, with a plain a deep midnight-indigo center.
Material and style for every element: sleek white titanium edging with thin gold-foil insulation trim and satellite-style hinge brackets with small coral and mint indicator lights. Crisp polished game-UI asset rendering, front view, evenly lit, consistent style across all four elements. The center panels are smooth and plain. No text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no icons, no background, no drop shadow, no scene.
